name: Samurai Jeans

prices.note: US storefront (en-us, USD; the Japanese storefront prices the same jeans at ¥29,800–¥41,800, https://samurai-jeans.com/collections/samurai-jeans/products.json?limit=250). samurai-jeans collection: 31 products of type Jeans; S002SP shorts excluded; 11 sold out excluded; none marked down; 19 regular-price jeans $376–$527. Low: S710SC-KI Japanese Cotton Natural color jeans ($376); S0510XXII 15oz Regular Straight and S0710XX 15oz Slim Straight ($401); 19oz and 21oz models $413–$426; high: S310BRX Brown Denim Super Wide model ($489–$527 by size).

notes: Store description (meta.json): Osaka-based maker of original MADE IN JAPAN jeans, making its denim fabric from scratch ('生地からオリジナルで製作').

Shipping policy: overseas shipping ¥6,000, free over ¥50,000; EMS/FedEx/DHL; duties and customs at the destination are the customer's (https://samurai-jeans.com/policies/shipping-policy). free_shipping_min_usd left empty (threshold stated in yen only).
Returns: request within 14 days of arrival, unworn, unwashed, tags on; hemmed and made-to-order items can't be returned (https://samurai-jeans.com/policies/refund-policy).
Jeans waists (products.json): 28–36, 38, 40 on most; 42, 44, 46 on 11 styles. Fabric weights 15oz–21oz in titles.
